entities.name: Ula
entities.description: Zendikar merfolk god of the realms of water, creator of the seas, born of long-lost memories of Ulamog.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi whose long-lost memories are the source of Ula and Mangeni.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People who know the sea god as Mangeni.

entities.name: Ula's Guardians
entities.description: Two massive leviathans said to flank Ula.

entities.name: Lighthouse at Sea Gate
entities.description: Research facility run by Ula-creed merfolk.

relations.note: Ula and Mangeni come from Ulamog's long-lost memories.
relations.quote: come from the same source: long-lost memories of the terrible Eldrazi Ulamog
